title.en: Can one 4B reranker replace the unfinished cascade and still fit a phone?
title.ru: Может ли один reranker 4B заменить незаконченный каскад и поместиться в телефон?

hypothesis.en: Qwen3-Reranker-4B will pass the same relevance gate that 0.6B failed, and a phone-sized Q4 or Q5 copy will preserve its decisions without adding a lost useful source.
hypothesis.ru: Qwen3-Reranker-4B пройдёт тот же gate релевантности, который не прошла 0,6B, а телефонная копия Q4 или Q5 сохранит решения и не потеряет дополнительный полезный источник.

exam.threshold_rule: Exactly the unchanged Gate 3C.4 calibration rule.
exam.note: This reuses the already opened 24-pair exam to compare model size and quantization only. It is not new held-out evidence about the task family.

source_model.instruction: Given a question, decide whether the passage contains information that directly helps answer that question.

runtime.backend: CPU on yukabox for the quality test

decision: If either Q4 or Q5 passes both gates, it becomes the single phone acceptance candidate. Otherwise keep the 0.6B-first cascade hypothesis alive.
not_tested: truth, privacy, and final answer quality
